answer: Locks are recorded in garden, expire in whisper, and onyx lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 182 aliases therefore needs 26 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 18 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2311 identities would post 4268 proofs and burn roughly 60 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
